demo.program:
# North Korea — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of North Korea?", "Pyongyang"),
    ("What currency does North Korea use?", "Won"),
    ("What is capital?", "Pyongyang"),
    ("What is currency?", "Won (KPW)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+850"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".kp"),
    ("What is driving side?", "right"),
    ("What is continent?", "Asia"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
